text.jp:
見つけたぞ……
お前が挑戦状の主だな？
text.official_en:
You issued the duel challenge, yes? I am here to
answer it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あぁ……俺の名は吸血鬼ボルヘス！
黒き戦士よ、お前の血を寄こすがいい！
text.official_en:
Yesss... I am Borges, the Bloodsucker! Black-clad
killer, I will feast upon your blood!
text.real_en:
Yesss... I am Vampire Borges! Black-clad
killer, I will feast upon your blood!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
成程、面白い技を使うものだ……
私も使ってみるとしよう。
text.official_en:
Your technique was fascinating to behold. Perhaps I
shall try it myself.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
オレの名は鷹斬りアギーレ！
この技の冴え、その身で味わうがいい！
text.official_en:
I am Aguirre, known as Hawk-Killer! Your body will
soon well know my lethal skill!
text.real_en:
I am Hawk-Slasher Aguirre! Your body will
soon well know my lethal skill!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
飛翔する相手に特化した戦技か……
興味深い。使ってみるとしよう。
text.official_en:
A combat art suited to flying foes... Intriguing. I may
soon give it a try.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
双頭蛇セピエンテ。
我が挑戦を受けていただき、感謝いたす……！
text.official_en:
You may call me Sepente, the Amphisbaena. I am
grateful you accepted my challenge.
text.real_en:
You may call me Two-Headed Serpent Sepente. I am
grateful you accepted my challenge.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
回避と追撃に特化した戦技……
言うなれば後の先か。試してみるとしよう。
text.official_en:
A combat art of avoidance and follow-up attacks...
Quite useful to counter foes. It is worth a try!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
人呼んで、巨人殺しのカミロ。
俺と闘え……そして、生の実感をくれ！
text.official_en:
I am Camilo, known to all as the Giant-Hunter! Now,
to battle, brave warrior! Let us live strong this day!
text.real_en:
I am Giant-Slayer Camilo! Now,
to battle, brave warrior! Let us live strong this day!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
体躯の大きい相手に特化した技か……
なかなか愉しめそうだな。使ってみるとしよう。
text.official_en:
A means especially to attack large foes? What fun.
I can see the use of it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
飛槍のイル・イラ。
あんたの力で、あたしを恐怖させてみな！
text.official_en: I'm Il-Lara, the Piercer! You don't scare me!
text.real_en: I'm Il-Ira of the Flying Spear! You don't scare me!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なかなか使えそうな投擲術だ。
槍を手にした時に、試してみるとしよう……
text.official_en:
A useful technique for throwing a spear. If ever I
wield one, I ought to keep it in mind.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
我が名は剣狩り騎カバイエ。
騎兵こそが、最強だって教えてやるよ……！
text.official_en:
My name is Cabaye, the Slashing Blur. I will prove to
you the superiority of cavalry!
text.real_en:
My name is Sword-Hunting Knight Cabaye. I will prove to
you the superiority of cavalry!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
必殺剣の使い手を想定した技か……
面白い。この技、私も試してみよう。
text.official_en:
A technique that anticipates an opponent using
Deadly Blade. Useful!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
人呼んで乾坤一射ダミアン。
我が戦いの極意、味わうがよい……
text.official_en:
They call me Sky-Shot, but my name is Damien. My
piercing shots never miss.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
超長距離からの狙撃か……
単純だが美しい。覚えておこう。
text.official_en:
A shot targeted from great distance. Simple
and beautiful. I will not forget this.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
私の名は聖拳ベレンゲラ。
この破邪の拳で貴様に正道を示してやろう！
text.official_en:
My name is Berenguela, the Holy Fist! The purity of
my will shall set you upon the correct path.
text.real_en:
My name is Holy Fist Berenguela! The purity of
my will shall set you upon the correct path.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
浄化の打撃術とは、珍しいな。
この技……私も試してみよう。
text.official_en: A holy brawler? A rare technique. It could be useful.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
俺は必滅のオウコ。修行の果てに
編み出した神殺しの剣……その身で味わえ。
text.official_en:
I am Oko, called Devastator. My sword has been
honed to slay the gods over many years.
text.real_en:
I am Ouko of Certain Destruction. My sword has been
honed to slay the gods over many years.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
より必殺へと至る剣か……実に見事だ。
この技……私も試してみることにしよう。
text.official_en:
A sword technique perfected for fatal strikes! Truly
magnificent. I must attempt it.
